# Charlotte Preparatory School — Summer Programs — Summer 2026 Costs

Every price on this page is for **summer 2026** (seven weeks, June 8 – July 31, 2026). No summer 2027 prices had been published as of October 19, 2026.

The school published its 2026 prices in two places, and they do not always match:

- the **brochure**, posted in December 2025 (https://issuu.com/charlottepreparatoryschool/docs/summer_adventures_2026)
- the **registration form**, as preserved on February 26, 2026 (https://web.archive.org/web/20260226113337/https://charlotteprep.org/community/summer-camp-registration). Its header reads: "Early Bird Discount — Take advantage of $25 savings per week now through January 15, 2026. Discounted prices reflected below."

Both figures are shown wherever they differ. Neither has been averaged or chosen over the other.

### Early-Bird Pricing

The registration form offered "$25 savings per week" through January 15, 2026, and said the prices it showed were the discounted ones.

**It is not clear which published prices are early-bird and which are regular.**

- For Traditional Camp in weeks 3–7, the form's prices are exactly $25 below the brochure's ($500 against $525 full day, $250 against $275 half day). That fits the early-bird note.
- In other rows, the form's price matches the brochure, or is even higher.
- The form was captured on February 26, 2026, six weeks after the early-bird deadline, but it still displayed the early-bird header.

The safest reading for planning is that the **brochure figures are the regular 2026 prices**.

### Traditional Camp (Weekly)

| Week | Dates (2026) | Full day, brochure | Full day, form | Half day, brochure | Half day, form |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Week 1 | June 8–12 | $525 | $525 | $275 | $275 |
| Week 2 | June 15–18 (4 days) | $420 | $420 | $175 | $225 |
| Week 3 | June 22–26 | $525 | $500 | $275 | $250 |
| Week 4 | July 6–10 | $525 | $500 | $275 | $250 |
| Week 5 | July 13–17 | $525 | $500 | $275 | $250 |
| Week 6 | July 20–24 | $525 | $500 | $275 | $250 |
| Week 7 | July 27–31 | $525 | $500 | $275 | $250 |

The Week 2 half-day price is the clearest conflict. The brochure says $175, but the form charges $225, which is more than the brochure and so cannot be an early-bird discount.

### Young Adventurers (Weekly)

| Week | Dates (2026) | Full day, brochure | Full day, form | Half day, brochure | Half day, form |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Week 1 | June 8–12 | $500 | $500 | $250 | $250 |
| Week 2 | June 15–18 (4 days) | $400 | $400 | $200 | $200 |
| Week 3 | June 22–26 | $500 | $525 | $250 | $250 |
| Week 4 | July 6–10 | $500 | $500 | $250 | $250 |
| Week 5 | July 13–17 | $500 | $500 | $250 | $250 |
| Week 6 | July 20–24 | $500 | $500 | $250 | $250 |
| Week 7 | July 27–31 | $500 | $500 | $250 | $250 |

The two sources agree on Young Adventurers in every cell but one: Week 3 full day, $500 in the brochure and $525 on the form.

### Specialty Camps (Full Day, One Week)

| Camp | Week (2026) | Brochure | Form |
|---|---|---|---|
| Art Explorers Workshop | June 8–12 | $600 | $600 |
| Rhythm & Beats Music | June 15–18 (4 days) | $500 | $500 |
| Broadway Bound Juniors | June 22–26 | $550 | $525 |
| GameMakers Coding Camp | July 6–10 | $550 | $550 |
| Master Makers: LEGO Engineering | July 13–17 | $550 | not offered |
| Quantum Creators Camp | July 20–24 | $550 | $550 |
| Junior Gourmet Cooking Lab | July 27–31 | $600 | $600 |

### Athletic Adventurers (Full Day, One Week)

| Camp | Week (2026) | Brochure | Form |
|---|---|---|---|
| Amazing Athletes | June 8–12 | $500 | $500 |
| Kidokinetics | June 15–18 (4 days) | $400 | $400 |
| Basketball Camp | July 6–10 | $500 | $500 |
| Kidokinetics | July 13–17 | $500 | $500 |
| Volleyball Camp | July 20–24 | $500 | $500 |
| Nike Soccer Camp | June 22–26 and July 27–31 | "See Nike website" | separate registration |

### The Nike Soccer Camp (Third-Party Prices)

The Nike Soccer Camp was priced and sold by US Sports Camps, not by Charlotte Prep. Its own page listed these 2026 prices, as captured on February 26, 2026 (https://web.archive.org/web/20260226113415/https://www.ussportscamps.com/soccer/nike/nike-soccer-camp-charlotte-prep-school):

| Option | Hours | Price per week |
|---|---|---|
| Half Day | 9:00am-12:00pm | $299 |
| Full Day | 9:00am-3:00pm | $429 |

Lunch is not included. US Sports Camps also offered a team discount for groups of 4 or more, through a code it issues on request.

### Junior Counselor Program

Rising or graduated 8th graders: "Full-day Traditional Camps at a reduced rate of **$300 per week**." The registration form charges $300 in every week, including the 4-day week of June 15–18.

### Before and After Care

"For your convenience, Before and After Care are offered 5 days a week at the following rates."

| Option | Hours | Brochure (per week) | Form, most weeks | Form, June 15–18 (4 days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Before Care | 8:00–9:00 a.m. | $60 per week | $60 | $55 |
| After Care | 4:00–5:00 p.m. | $60 per week | $60 | $55 |
| Both Before and After Care | 8:00–9:00 a.m. and 4:00–5:00 p.m. | $110 per week | $110 | $100 |

Care is booked week by week on the form. In the FAQ's words: "Before care is between 8:00 a.m.–9:00 a.m. After care pick-up is between 4:00–5:00 p.m." No later pick-up option is published.

### Midsummer Tune-Up Tutoring

An optional add-on for Traditional campers, run by Charlotte Prep teachers in groups of 6 or fewer.

| Option | Time | Price |
|---|---|---|
| Session 1 | 9:00–9:50 a.m. | $60 per week |
| Session 2 | 10:00–10:50 a.m. | $60 per week |
| Session 3 | 11:00–11:50 a.m. | $60 per week |
| All 3 | 9:00–11:50 a.m. | $150 per week |

The brochure summarises: "All Midsummer Tune-Up sessions are $60 a piece or $150 for all 3 sessions per week." Rising MK–2nd graders meet Monday–Wednesday and rising 3rd–5th graders Thursday–Friday. The form offers every session in all seven weeks at the same price, including the 4-day week.

### What Is Included in the Price

- **Lunch:** "Lunch is provided for all full-day campers in our all-new, state-of-the-art cafeteria, 'the Lair.'" There is no separate lunch charge.
- **Snacks:** "We will also offer a morning and afternoon snack for all campers."
- **Field trips:** both Young Adventurers and Traditional Camp describe weekly field trips. No separate field-trip fee is published.
- **No registration fee or deposit** is published. The FAQ heading asks "Is lunch included in the registration fee?", but no fee amount appears anywhere.

### Payment, Refunds and Deadlines

From the brochure FAQ, verbatim: "Payment is due at the time of registration. Refunds are available up to two weeks before camp starts. A refund fee of $150 will apply per camper."

- **Payment:** in full at registration, by credit or debit card. The form shows a single "Credit Card" method.
- **Refund deadline:** two weeks before camp starts.
- **Refund fee:** $150 per camper.
- **Early-bird deadline:** January 15, 2026 ($25 off per week).
- **Registration closed:** Friday, May 29, 2026.
- **Discount codes:** the form has a "Discount Code" box, but no code or code-based discount is published.

### Planning a Whole Summer

Two worked examples, using the brochure's regular prices:

- **Seven weeks of full-day Traditional Camp** comes to 6 × $525 + $420 = **$3,570**. Adding Before and After Care every week adds $110 × 7 = $770 (at the brochure's flat weekly rate), for **$4,340**.
- **Seven weeks of full-day Young Adventurers** comes to 6 × $500 + $400 = **$3,400**.

These totals are calculated here and were not published by the school.

### Not Published for 2026

- Sibling or multi-week discounts. Charlotte Prep gives a 3% younger-sibling discount on school-year tuition, but nothing says it applies to camp.
- Financial aid for camp.
- A late-pickup fee or policy.
- A separate price for the 4-day week of the Junior Counselor Program (it is $300, the same as every other week).
- Prices for summer 2027.

sections.text:
# Charlotte Preparatory School — Summer Programs — Summer Adventures 2026 Catalog

Everything on this page describes **summer 2026**. Charlotte Prep's camp, "Summer Adventures at Prep", ran seven weeks from June 8 to July 31, 2026 on the Boyce Road campus. The school's summer pages have since been taken down, and no summer 2027 camp had been announced as of October 19, 2026. The record below comes from the school's own 2026 camp brochure and its 2026 registration form, both preserved online.

### Who the 2026 Camp Was For

The school's FAQ says camp was "Open to all students PK-8" — not only Charlotte Prep families. The registration form asked "Does your child currently attend Charlotte Prep?" and, if not, which school the child attends.

The camp was organised into four families of camps, plus a teen helper programme:

- **Young Adventurers** — rising Primary and Transitional Kindergarten (the youngest campers, roughly ages 3 to 5)
- **Traditional Camp** — classic day camp, full or half day
- **Specialty Camps** — one week-long themed camp each week, full day only
- **Athletic Adventurers** — one sports camp each week, full day only (except the Nike Soccer Camp, which is run separately)
- **Junior Counselor Program** — rising or graduated 8th graders

The brochure called Young Adventurers and Athletic Adventurers new for 2026: "This year, we are proud to offer our Young Adventurers camps for our youngest campers and our Athletic Adventurers camps for those campers seeking a sporty summer experience."

### Camp Hours

From the brochure FAQ, verbatim:

- **Full Day:** 9:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m.
- **Half Day (morning):** 9:00 a.m.–12:00 p.m.
- **Half Day (afternoon):** 1:00–4:00 p.m.

Half-day families chose AM or PM on the registration form. Optional Before Care ran 8:00–9:00 a.m. and After Care 4:00–5:00 p.m., at extra cost (see the Summer 2026 Costs page).

### The Seven Weeks of Summer 2026

Camp was closed on June 19 (Juneteenth) and for the whole week of June 29 to July 3. In the school's words: "Please note that the camp is closed on June 19 and from June 29 to July 3."

| Week | Dates (2026) | Days | Specialty camp | Athletic camp |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Week 1 | June 8–12 | Mon–Fri | Art Explorers Workshop | Amazing Athletes |
| Week 2 | June 15–18 | Mon–Thu (4-day week) | Rhythm & Beats Music | Kidokinetics |
| Week 3 | June 22–26 | Mon–Fri | Broadway Bound Juniors | Nike Soccer (separate registration) |
| — | June 29 – July 3 | Closed | — | — |
| Week 4 | July 6–10 | Mon–Fri | GameMakers Coding Camp | Basketball |
| Week 5 | July 13–17 | Mon–Fri | Master Makers: LEGO Engineering (brochure only — see note) | Kidokinetics |
| Week 6 | July 20–24 | Mon–Fri | Quantum Creators Camp | Volleyball |
| Week 7 | July 27–31 | Mon–Fri | Junior Gourmet Cooking Lab | Nike Soccer (separate registration) |

Young Adventurers, Traditional Camp and the Junior Counselor Program ran in **all seven weeks**.

**Note on Week 5:** the December 2025 brochure lists Master Makers: LEGO Engineering (rising MK–5, $550) for July 13–17. The registration form captured on February 26, 2026 does **not** offer it — its only Week 5 specialty option is Kidokinetics. Whether the LEGO camp ran is not published.

### Young Adventurers (Rising Primary and TK)

"Designed for campers to grow in curiosity through play, imagination, and hands-on exploration in a warm, nurturing environment."

- "Each week features exciting themed activities, including water days, nature walks, creative arts and crafts, and fun-filled field trips that spark curiosity and wonder."
- "A quiet nap time is offered to help our youngest adventurers recharge."
- Full-day and half-day options; full-day camps include lunch.
- The registration form labels it "Young Adventurers (ES P/TK)" — Early School Primary and Transitional Kindergarten.
- The school held a Young Adventurers Camp Information Meeting on January 22 (2026) at 5:30 p.m. in the Lower School cafeteria, "The Lair."

### Traditional Camp

"Campers will experience the classic summer camp vibe with games, crafts, and outdoor adventures packed with variety, excitement, and memorable adventures!"

- "Each week features engaging activities and off-campus field trips, along with special surprises such as karaoke parties, ice cream and snow cone pop-ups, picnic days, and more."
- Full-day and half-day options.
- Traditional campers could add the optional Midsummer Tune-Up tutoring sessions (see below).

**Grade band — two school sources disagree.** The brochure says "Rising MK-8 Students" and the FAQ says "All rising MK-8 students are eligible to sign up for traditional summer camps." The registration form lists every Traditional Camp week as "Traditional Camp (K-7)". Rising 8th graders were offered the Junior Counselor Program instead on that form. Both are recorded here; the form is the later document.

### Specialty Camps

"Dive into passions like science, art, coding, or drama through immersive, week-long experiences designed to spark creativity, curiosity, and hands-on learning." The brochure states: "All Specialty Camps are Full-Day Camps."

| Camp | Week (2026) | Rising grades (brochure) | Grades (registration form) | What it is, per the brochure |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Art Explorers Workshop | June 8–12 | MK–8 | K-8 | A creative-arts camp |
| Rhythm & Beats Music | June 15–18 | MK–8 | K-8 | A music camp |
| Broadway Bound Juniors | June 22–26 | MK–8 | K-8 | A "performing arts camp" |
| GameMakers Coding Camp | July 6–10 | 2–8 | 2-8 | Coding — "Bring ideas to life" |
| Master Makers: LEGO Engineering | July 13–17 | MK–5 | not on the form | "Explore cutting-edge science" |
| Quantum Creators Camp | July 20–24 | 2–6 | 2-6 | "Quantum Creators Advanced STEM" |
| Junior Gourmet Cooking Lab | July 27–31 | MK–8 | K-8 | "Campers can whip up delicious dishes" |

The brochure's pricing table on page 10 dates Broadway Bound Juniors "June 22–27", and the registration form reads "June 22-27 Broadway Bound Juniors". Page 6 of the same brochure says June 22–26. The 27th is a Saturday, so June 22–26 is almost certainly meant.

### Athletic Adventurers

"Build confidence and skills through sports and fitness with an action-packed summer filled with movement, teamwork, and fun." The brochure states: "All Athletic Adventures Camps are Full-Day Camps (except Nike Soccer Camp)."

| Camp | Week (2026) | Grades (registration form) | Detail |
|---|---|---|---|
| Amazing Athletes | June 8–12 | K-8 | A "multi-sports program" |
| Kidokinetics | June 15–18 | K-8 | "Sports and physical education enrichment"; 4-day week |
| Nike Soccer Camp | June 22–26 | ages 6–13 (provider's page) | Run by US Sports Camps; register on their site |
| Basketball Camp | July 6–10 | K-8 | — |
| Kidokinetics | July 13–17 | K-8 | Full 5-day week |
| Volleyball Camp | July 20–24 | K-8 | — |
| Nike Soccer Camp | July 27–31 | ages 6–13 (provider's page) | Run by US Sports Camps; register on their site |

The brochure says grade levels are given in "individual camp descriptions", but it prints none for the athletic camps; the grades above come from the registration form.

**Who runs them.** The school says: "In addition to Charlotte Prep coaches, several of our Athletic Adventures Camps will be hosted by local and national vendors." Amazing Athletes and Kidokinetics carry outside "Click Here for More Info" links in the brochure. The school does not say which camps its own coaches ran.

### Nike Soccer Is a Separate Camp

The Nike Soccer Camp used Charlotte Prep's campus but was **not** part of Summer Adventures registration. It was run by US Sports Camps, and families registered on that company's website: https://www.ussportscamps.com/soccer/nike/nike-soccer-camp-charlotte-prep-school

Per the provider's page (2026 season):

- Dates: June 22-26, 2026 and July 27-31, 2026 (Mon-Fri)
- Ages 6-13, coed
- Half-Day Hours: 9:00am-12:00pm; Day Camp Hours: 9:00am-3:00pm
- "Lunch is NOT included"
- Held at Founders Field, with check-in in the Charlotte Preparatory School parking lot
- Camp Director: Prince Ojok

Prices for this camp are on the Summer 2026 Costs page.

### Midsummer Tune-Up Tutoring

An optional add-on of short morning academic sessions. The brochure: "When registering for a Traditional Camp, families may choose to add morning academic sessions to enrich their camper's day. All tutoring sessions are run by Charlotte Prep teachers and will consist of small groups of 6 or less students, ensuring personalized, focused attention."

| Session | Time | Rising MK–2nd Grade (Monday–Wednesday) | Rising 3rd–5th Grade (Thursday–Friday) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Session 1 | 9:00–9:50 a.m. | Literacy & Reading Adventures | Reading & Writing Workshop |
| Session 2 | 10:00–10:50 a.m. | Math Explorers | Math Challenges |
| Session 3 | 11:00–11:50 a.m. | Social Skills & Teamwork | Critical Thinking & Strategy |

"NOTE: All sessions include a 10-minute break."

### Junior Counselor Program

"Rising or graduated 8th graders can participate in The Junior Counselor Program. This program offers our older campers leadership opportunities and hands-on experience, while they assist counselors with the younger campers in our Traditional Camps."

"Please note that there are limited spots available and these positions may require an interview."

### Lunch and Snacks

"All full-time campers will enjoy free lunch daily in our new state-of-the-art cafeteria, 'The Lair.' Snack will also be provided to all campers in the morning and the afternoon." Half-day campers get the snacks but not lunch.

### Registration for 2026

- Registration was an online form on the school's website, paid by credit or debit card.
- "Registration ends on Friday, May 29, 2026."
- Children in the school-year Extended-Day Program were **not** automatically enrolled: "the Extended-Day Program no longer includes registration for Summer Adventures at Prep. All current Extended-Day students MUST be registered for camp through the registration website."
- Questions went to camp contact Mickey Stone, mstone@charlotteprep.org.

### What Summer 2026 Did Not Publish

- Swimming: the brochure mentions "water days" for Young Adventurers but no swim lessons or pool.
- Camper-to-counselor ratios, and the number of places per camp. The only group size published is the tutoring "6 or less".
- Which Athletic Adventurers camps were run by Charlotte Prep coaches and which by outside vendors.
- Grade bands for the athletic camps in the brochure itself.
- Any summer 2027 programme.
